image_description: A dense, top-down collage of numerous audio cassette tapes arranged in a grid-like pattern. The cassettes vary in color (black, white, clear, blue, red) and label design. Most show the standard rectangular shape with two spool windows. Some labels contain text, though much of it is small or stylized.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small rectangular plastic enclosure fitting comfortably in palm with thickness much smaller than width or height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects clearly exhibit the aspect ratio and relative thinness characteristic of compact cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flat rectangular prism with rounded corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible units maintain the standard rectangular form factor with softened corners typical of injection-molded plastic shells.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two circular holes revealing tape spools inside.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dual circular apertures for the spools are consistently present on the face of each cassette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two spools of magnetic tape visible through circular holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Dark circular shapes representing the spools/wound tape are visible within the windows of most cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular opening at bottom exposing tape for player head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a top-down view of the front face; the bottom edge where the tape exposure slot resides is largely occluded or viewed at an angle where the internal mechanism is not clearly distinguishable from the shell thickness.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface has molded details screw holes tape guide slots and write-protect tabs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While small, indentations corresponding to screw holes and the general structure of the shell (including ridges for tabs) are visible on several clearer examples (e.g., the white cassette in the lower middle).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Casing transparent or opaque plastic typically black gray or clear.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The materials appear consistent with plastic, ranging from opaque blacks/whites to semi-transparent blues and clears.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label area on one face displaying track information artist and title.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Every cassette features a distinct label area with printed graphics and text layouts typical of music releases.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Visible internal spools through transparent casing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: In the semi-transparent cases (e.g., the blue one), the internal structure and spools are faintly visible through the plastic body.

artifact_observations.location: Labels on multiple cassettes, particularly upper right and center-left
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the layout mimics text, close inspection reveals that many character strings are nonsensical, melted, or illegible 'AI-text' rather than crisp, readable typography. This is common in AI generations of text-heavy objects.

artifact_observations.location: Edges between adjacent cassettes, specifically center-right cluster
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight bleeding or fusion of boundaries between tightly packed cassettes. The separation lines are not perfectly sharp, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity in the dense packing.
The perspective lines of the bottom-left cassette seem slightly inconsistent with the flat lay of the others, appearing subtly warped or 'soft' in its rectangular definition.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity of the objects as audio cassettes and rule out similar rectangular electronics.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structural integrity of the text on the labels, which is a high-risk area for AI artifacts.
To check for boundary bleeding between the densely packed objects and ensure each cassette is a distinct, closed topology.
To assess overall texture consistency and detect any subtle global distortions or noise patterns.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on cassette labels
Sharpness of boundaries between adjacent cassettes
Consistency of spool geometry across all instances
Plastic material reflectivity and transparency effects
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is completely gibberish, increase the artifact severity. Check if the boundary auditor finds any fused cassettes that the router missed. Ensure the classifier confirms these are actually cassettes and not just generic rectangular boxes with circles.
